clue.text: 10 wives (not 5) take in quietly the gift of the fairies

explanation.surface: Three wives, short of a few, receiving a fairy gift on the quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: Throughout the puzzle 10 stands for THREE, the first word of 10/12; here it precedes the answer to make THREE WISHES. WIVES loses V and takes SH inside: WI-SH-ES.
explanation.definitionFit: In fairy stories a good fairy grants a person a set of wishes, typically three of them, as her present.

clue.text: Rupert's works sound huge
